normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter only exists to feed the transfer/transferFrom balance writes and should be folded into the transfer function node.
The tokens parameter is a transient amount value consumed by transfer and its safeSub/safeAdd operations, so it can be merged into the transfer function.
The spender parameter only indexes the allowed mapping inside approve and carries no standalone semantic value.
The from parameter is only used to index balances and allowed within transferFrom and can be merged into that function.
The _newOwner parameter is immediately stored into the newOwner state variable and has no independent semantics.
The tokenAddress parameter is only used for the external ERC20 call inside transferAnyERC20Token.
The data parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback within approveAndCall.
